The `TarUtils.parseOctal` method is responsible for parsing octal values from a byte array. It iterates over the byte array, skipping leading spaces, and then converts the octal characters to a long integer.

The current bug report states that the `TarArchiveEntry.parseTarHeader` method includes the trailing space/NUL when parsing the octal size. It mentions that although the size field in the header is 12 bytes, only 11 octal digits are allowed, with the last byte supposed to be a space or NUL character.

Looking at the `TarUtils.parseOctal` method, we can see that it iterates over the bytes in the array and stops when it encounters a NUL character. However, it does not explicitly handle the trailing space or NUL character mentioned in the bug report. This could lead to the issue described in the bug report where the trailing space/NUL is included when parsing the octal size.

To fix this issue, we need to modify the `TarUtils.parseOctal` method to handle the trailing space or NUL character correctly when parsing the octal value.

Next, I will provide the best location to fix this issue.
```java
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarUtils.parseOctal(byte[], int, int)
```

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
